description: ac plan-execution hooks: SessionStart surfaces active plan state, plus the slug, phase and note of a coordinator run this session owns (and, after a compaction, what compaction did to the skill bodies); Stop blocks a turn-ending attempt while an execute run is still in flight and guards autonomous mode completion (stop-guard-auto.sh) and a coordinator run, blocking a turn that ends with no verdict and nothing running (stop-guard-coordinate.sh, 3 blocks per phase), and in every session continues a turn that ends on an announced step, an offer to continue, or a prose question once a Sonnet judge confirms the regex match (stop-guard-announce.sh, 1 block per stall and 3 per prompt, interactive sessions only); all four Stop guards allow the stop while background work that will wake the session is in flight (hooks/lib/wake-count.jq); PreToolUse scopes subagent file edits to the active wave and steers native plan mode to /ac:plan, and, while this session owns an ac:auto away marker, denies AskUserQuestion and gates Bash: outward git and gh verbs only when the marker's allowed_outward names them, irreversible ones never (pretooluse-bash-guard.sh). A second PreToolUse registration caps one ac:explore spawn's tool calls, scoped by the agent_type the harness supplies. PostToolUse keeps an auto-memory topic note under 40 lines and 3072 bytes (a write that grows it past either gets a condense instruction; AC_MEMORY_NOTE_MAX_LINES and AC_MEMORY_NOTE_MAX_BYTES; sub-indexes exempt) and an auto-memory MEMORY.md under 80 lines, 10240 bytes and 150 bytes per line, overridable through AC_MEMORY_INDEX_MAX_LINES, AC_MEMORY_INDEX_MAX_BYTES and AC_MEMORY_INDEX_MAX_LINE_BYTES (0 turns one check off), by handing Claude a consolidation instruction after a write that leaves it over budget (posttooluse-memory-index-budget.sh). A second hook on the same Write and Edit matcher runs the command-line analyzer on an edited Dart or PHP file (dart analyze; php -l plus phpstan when the project ships it) and hands the result to Claude as ground truth against stale LSP diagnostics; AC_CLI_DIAGNOSTICS=0 turns it off (posttooluse-cli-diagnostics.sh). A PreToolUse registration on Write, Edit and MultiEdit denies a write to a memory file (CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/*.md, PROJECT.md, DESIGN.md) until the transcript shows its writer skill was loaded, as a Skill call, a Read of its SKILL.md or the slash command, and names the skill to load; AC_MEMORY_FILE_GATE=0 turns it off (pretooluse-memory-file-gate.sh). A third hook on the PostToolUse Write and Edit matcher holds those files to a budget (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and rule files 120 lines and 12288 bytes, CLAUDE.local.md 60 lines and 6144 bytes, PROJECT.md 150 lines, DESIGN.md 300 lines, overridable through AC_CLAUDE_MD_MAX_LINES, AC_CLAUDE_MD_MAX_BYTES, AC_CLAUDE_LOCAL_MD_MAX_LINES, AC_CLAUDE_LOCAL_MD_MAX_BYTES, AC_RULE_MAX_LINES, AC_RULE_MAX_BYTES, AC_PROJECT_MD_MAX_LINES and AC_DESIGN_MD_MAX_LINES, 0 turns one check off) by handing Claude a consolidation instruction after a write that leaves one over budget; AC_MEMORY_FILE_BUDGET=0 turns it off (posttooluse-memory-file-budget.sh). Another PostToolUse registration answers an AskUserQuestion that timed out with the user away: it tells Claude to wait and end the turn, and arms the latch the Stop guards honour, unless this session owns a live ac:auto or ac:coordinate run and the question is not a blocker, in which case it says to continue and record the choice as not user-approved; AC_QUESTION_TIMEOUT=0 turns it off (posttooluse-question-timeout.sh). UserPromptSubmit keeps the session title current when AC_SESSION_TITLE=1: on the first typed prompt and every AC_SESSION_TITLE_EVERY-th (default 10) a detached Haiku call names the session from its recent turns, through a prompt the user can replace (AC_SESSION_TITLE_PROMPT, or ~/.claude/ac/session-title.md), the name is applied on the next prompt, and a title the user set stops it for that session (userpromptsubmit-session-title.sh). A second SessionStart registration delivers the ac working rules (references/working-rules.md) as additionalContext, and keeps the stable copy a wrapper appends current under AC_WORKING_RULES_DIR; it stays silent when AC_WORKING_RULES=0, when AC_WORKING_RULES_APPENDED=1, when AC_GLOBAL_CLAUDE_MD still carries a moved heading, and on a resume whose transcript already holds the rules (session-start-working-rules.sh). A PreToolUse registration on Bash denies an unbounded search from an ac subagent: find or a recursive grep, rg or fd rooted at / or the home directory, a search over ~/.claude/projects, and strings or grep -a on a file over 100 MiB, each deny naming a bounded recipe; for the four ac:plan-worker-* agents, general-purpose and the main thread it also denies once per command a small sed -i, perl -pi or python .replace( edit and points at the Edit tool (AC_BASH_EDIT_GUARD=0 turns that off) (pretooluse-subagent-bash-guard.sh). A third PreToolUse registration on Bash, in every session, denies the zsh-only expansions Claude Code's bash parser cannot read (${(flags)name}, a subscript flag, a nested ${${...}}), which would otherwise stop at a dangerous-rm safety prompt that bypass mode does not skip, and names the bash rewrite (pretooluse-shell-syntax-guard.sh). A SubagentStop hook blocks an ac subagent once at its final report while a background task it started is still running, and asks it to TaskStop each one (subagentstop-background-guard.sh). A SessionEnd hook, and a SessionStart hook on startup, run ac lease sweep detached to stop the resources a session leased and the leases of sessions whose process is gone (session-lease-sweep.sh). Every hook fails open.
